task: Write a threat model for Purser that every control traces to, then correct the public claims that the security audit falsified. No code changes in this phase; the build follows after review.
constraints: State residual risk plainly. No absolute safety claim may survive: loss is bounded by the hot balance, the window and time to detect, not by our code being correct.
Historical documents (plans, superseded specs) are corrected with a banner rather than silently rewritten.
No code changes in this phase. The existing 153 tests must still pass untouched.
Every adversary must carry an explicit loss bound.

n1.desc: Write docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-16-threat-model.md: invariant, trust boundaries, enumerated adversaries each with a loss bound, what bounds the loss (hot balance floor, signer window, detection), residual risk, and what we explicitly do not defend against
n1.accept: The document exists with all six required sections, enumerates at least five adversaries each carrying an explicit 'bounded by' statement, contains no absolute safety claim such as 'cannot drain the wallet', and has no em-dashes

gate.detail: OK: 7 adversaries, each with a stated loss bound

n2.desc: Correct the falsified claims: rewrite the README key custody and does-not-claim sections, add the drain finding to SECURITY.md known limitations, and put a superseded banner on the 2026-08-12 signer spec and plan
n2.accept: No live document claims a compromised daemon cannot drain the wallet; README states the bound explicitly and links the threat model; SECURITY.md lists the unbounded cumulative signing finding; both 2026-08-12 documents carry a banner pointing at the threat model; all 153 tests still pass and no em-dashes exist
n2.verify: cd ~/projects/purser && ! grep -riq 'cannot drain the wallet' README.md SECURITY.md && grep -q 'threat-model' README.md && grep -qi 'cumulative' SECURITY.md && grep -q 'Superseded' docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-privilege-separated-signer-design.md && grep -q 'Superseded' docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-12-privilege-separated-signer.md && pnpm vitest run --reporter=basic 2>&1 | grep -q '153 passed' && ! grep -rlP '\x{2014}' src test docs deploy README.md SECURITY.md
